newsitem.title: BRAZIL: BRAZIL CENBANK CLOSES DOWN EIGHT BANKS, BROKERAGES.
newsitem.headline: BRAZIL CENBANK CLOSES DOWN EIGHT BANKS, BROKERAGES.

text.p: The Brazilian Central Bank Monday ordered the liquidation of eight small banks and brokerages in connection with a long-running probe into irregular municipal debt issues, a spokeswoman said.
"The liquidations are connected with the investigation into irregularities involving municipal bonds issued to pay court-ordered debts," the spokeswoman said.

In circulars signed by outgoing president Gustavo Loyola, the central bank identified the institutions as Banco Porto Seguro SA, based in Sao Paulo; Cedro Distribuidora de Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios, based in Rio de Janeiro; and Banco Interfinance SA and its brokerage arm, based in Sao Paulo.

In addition, it closed down Astra Distribuidora de Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios of Rio de Janeiro; Valor Corretora de Cambio, Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios Ltda, based in Salvador; Hot Distribuidora de Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios of Rio de Janeiro; and Trader Distribuidora de Titulos e Valores Mobiliarios, also based in Rio de Janeiro.
Central Bank Director of Controls Claudio Mauch was due to hold a news conference later Monday.
The Central Bank has these past six months carried out a parallel investigation to a Senate inquiry into irregular bond issues by some states and municipalities.
